description: This source file defines the 'PoolingStreamBufferWriter' struct, which implements the 'IBufferWriter<byte>' interface for writing buffered data to a stream using pooled byte arrays for efficiency. It manages buffer resizing and stream writes, encapsulating buffer management and stream interaction in a reusable component within the Orleans serialization system.

classes.name: PoolingStreamBufferWriter
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> for writing to a Stream with pooled buffers, supporting buffer management, resizing, and stream writing.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Writes buffered data to the stream and updates the number of bytes written.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> segment for writing, resizing buffer if needed.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> for writing, resizing buffer if needed.

methods.name: Resize
methods.description: Resizes the internal buffer to accommodate additional data.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Returns the pooled buffer to the pool, releasing resources.
